target_title: Metaphone from Apache Commons Codec 1.3 (2005, real open-source code)

mutants.quirk: Repeated letters are skipped, except C ("ACCEPT" keeps both Cs' sounds)
A one-letter input is returned upper-cased without running the algorithm (the general path would index past the end)
An initial X is pronounced S ("XAVIER")
The T in TCH is silent ("MATCH")

modernizations.goal: Bring this class up to modern Java 21: generics instead of raw collections, java.time instead of Calendar, StringBuilder, no deprecated APIs. Behaviour must stay exactly the same.

Ticket SRCH-431 (tech debt): Metaphone is Java 1.4-era code - StringBuffer, char arrays, a 170-line switch and duplicated special-case branches. Refactor it for readability with modern Java 21: StringBuilder, switch expressions, small helper methods, and simplify the special-case handling. Keep the public API.
